unsupported_input_description: - `inputs/MA0139.1.tsv.gz` — gzipped, tab-delimited JASPAR 2022 CTCF motif track (MA0139.1, hg38/GRCh38). Each motif record has 7 fields: chromosome, 0-based half-open start/end, name, score, `pval` (motif strength, = −log10 p-value × 100; larger = stronger), strand (`+`/`-`). The file begins with a single header/preamble line that is not a motif record.
